You can do scenario analysis by changing loan parameters or key assumptions. See the impact on cash flow of changing loan parameters and choose the best fit.

complete basic information sheet. This contains basic information on the applicant and the business including loan request and its breakdown by purpose. Loan purpose is what the borrower plans to buy with the loan requested and owner contribution. Some consistency checks of encoded data is included.

Conduct business and character assessment by filling "(2) Bus.&Character assess" sheet. Start with listing credit history and rate the MSME using the 10 factors listed. Note: rating to be given for each factor needs to be well justified by writing notes and observations in the comments section for each of the factors rated. Ratings will be invalid unless it is well justified.
Complete (5) Collateral Worksheet based on information obtained from the applicant.

Go to sheet (6) Summary and Decision sheet. You have now completed your assessment and ready to make lending decision. The tool will help you to summarize qualitative, quantitative, E&S, and collateral assessments and propose lending decision. All the four lending criteria need to be fulfilled.

The tool has 7 sheets-numbered from 1-7. Sheet 1 contains basic client, business and loan information. Sheet 2 contains qualitative assessment and sheets 3 contain financial analysis including month-by-month cashflow. Sheet 4 contains environmental and social impact analysis of the business under review. Sheet 4 is dedicated for social and environmental assessment. it is a checklist to be completed by observing the business and interviewing the client. sheet 5 contains information entry on proposed collateral by the client. Sheet 6 presents summary of the qualitative and quantitative assessment with proposed loan decision. Sheet 7 is automated sheet used for calculation of loan and interest rapuemnt based on parameters encoded in sheet 1.

si.t: Qualitative assessment is scored out of 100. Applicant need to score over 75% to qualify for a loan. The tool alarms if borrower fails to pass the qualitative assessment as the loan appraisal shouldn't be continued.

1) start by completing Sales and purchase summary section on sheet (3)-Cash flow Analysis. First list major sales and purchase(raw material) items. indicate what % of the sales and purchases are made on credit. sales and purchase data can be encoded per day, week or month. hence choose the option that suits to the data collected as per convenience to the customers. include ending inventories for sales as well as purchase items to complete the section. Ending inventory refers to stocks of finished goods and raw materials and work in progress at the time of business visits. Complete percentage of credit and cash sales/ purchases in the spaces provided. the rest of the data will be automatically calculated and taken to respective places in balance sheet and income statement.

3) Complete the balance sheet data on yellow shaded cells. Then proceed to complete the expected growth rates for major items. Scroll to projected cash flow section and complete missing information, shaded yellow. Cash flow from operation is automatically filled. Complete seasonality information found at the top of the cash flow table. Months with average sales are given 100%, peak sales months will be above 100% and low sales months will be below 100%. Ex. If average sales is 10,000 and applicant informs you that during peak months sales raises to 12,000 and drops to 8000 during low months, you put 100% for average months, 120% for peak months and 80% for low months. cash flow from operation is automatically calculated and you need to encoded data relating to financing, investing and other activities in the respective sections of the cash flow statement. please encode inflows as a positive figure and outflows as negative figures.
